title: Why do we hiccup?
examples: Teacher, why do I make a little noise when I hiccup?
Does eating too much make you hiccup?
Is hiccupping bad for my body?

explain.say: A hiccup is a little sound that your body makes by itself.
A big muscle under your lungs jumps suddenly. You breathe in fast.
This muscle is called the diaphragm. It helps you breathe.
At the same time, your vocal cords snap shut very fast.
The jump and the snap make the hic sound.
Eating too fast or drinking fizzy drinks can start hiccups.

faq.q: Why do I hiccup? Is it always because of food?
faq.a: Hiccups happen when the diaphragm jumps and the vocal cords snap. Sometimes it is from food, but sometimes it is just from excitement.
asks: Is food the only reason for hiccups?

faq.a: No, hiccups are just little sounds and they do not hurt your body at all. They are just a funny little reflex.

faq.q: How can I stop hiccups if I have many?
faq.a: You can try holding your breath for a little while, or drinking some water slowly. These things can help calm the diaphragm.
asks: What should I do when I hiccup?

faq.a: The diaphragm is a large, important muscle located right under your lungs. It helps you breathe in and out.
Vocal cords are two small bands of tissue inside your voice box. They vibrate when you talk or make sounds.

facts: The diaphragm is a big muscle under your lungs.
Hiccups are caused by sudden spasms of the diaphragm.
The snapping of the vocal cords creates the 'hic' sound.

quiz.say: Which muscle jumps when you hiccup?
quiz.why: The diaphragm sits under your lungs. It jumps when you hiccup.

wrong.0: Your lungs hold air, and the muscle under them jumps.
wrong.1: Your arm muscle moves your arm.

options.show: the diaphragm jumps and the vocal cords snap shut
options.say: the diaphragm jumps and the vocal cords snap shut

quiz.why: The diaphragm jumps and the vocal cords snap shut. Together they make the hic.

wrong.1: A tummy rumble is a different sound, from your belly.
wrong.2: Teeth can click, but the hic comes from your throat.

quiz.say: Mei eats her lunch very fast. What might happen?
quiz.why: Eating too fast can make the diaphragm jump. That starts hiccups.

wrong.0: Eating fast can give you hiccups, but it will not make you sleepy.
wrong.2: Your voice stays the same after eating.
